findings: confirmed: QUICKSTART.md uses $sourceBucket, $kbId, and $dataSourceId for required KB upload/ingestion before its only output-retrieval section defines them. Retrieve SourceDataBucketName after the data stack, KnowledgeBaseId/DataSourceId after the AI stack, and BackendApiUrl after the backend stack.

confirmed: QUICKSTART.md incorrectly lists the CloudWatch BackendLogGroup as optional monitoring. BackendStack always creates it, so it must be identified as a backend-required resource and cost exposure.
